payload.heading: Annual service
payload.text: The boiler (Veritherm C30) needs an annual service every September or October. Last service: 2025-10-02 by Brightwell Heating. Warranty requires a service at least every 13 months.

payload.heading: Pressure
payload.text: Normal pressure is 1.0-1.5 bar when cold. If it drops below 0.8 bar, top up using the filling loop under the boiler.
